name: Audax Renovables, S.A.
summary: Audax Renovables, S.A. engages in the generation and supply of renewable electricity and gas in Spain, Portugal, the Netherlands, Hungary, Italy, Poland, Germany, and France. It has a portfolio of wind and photovoltaic farms with a capacity of 1,037 megawatts. The company also sells electricity and gas. Audax Renovables, S.A. was incorporated in 2000 and is based in Badalona, Spain. Audax Renovables, S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Electrica Nuriel, S.L.
